C2_expected_count_model.probability_assumption: Poisson count with lambda equal to C2 expected count; P(N>=1)=1-exp(-lambda), P(N=0)=exp(-lambda). This is not native C2 probability or empirical USGS probability.

frozen_mask_measure_before.S2_rule: drop type iff raw Overture count=0; no independent reference evidence

recommendation.caveat: C2 expected counts and Poisson probabilities are assumptions from provided features, not measured USGS counts. This recommendation is internal model coherence only, not target-accuracy evidence. Steward makes final choice; no upload is authorized here.
recommendation.reason: S2b replaces the unverified rule that every Overture-zero type is a USGS zero with the preregistered C2 expected-count boundary: only zero-count types with C2 expected count <0.5 are dropped; the C2 recipe itself marks zero-count types defined at expected count >=0.5.

structure_only_plausibility.adjacency_rule: same-region polygon pairs sharing positive boundary length in EPSG:5070; point-only touches excluded
structure_only_plausibility.interpretation_limit: These covariates and neighbor Overture counts can indicate sparse/dense structural context but cannot observe or validate a USGS zero.
structure_only_plausibility.source: Provided Overture tract summaries, provided ACS strata, and provided ACS tract polygons only.
